errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests, try again later
errors.CONFLICT: This already exists, or was changed at the same time. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: The request refers to something that does not exist.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Someone else changed this at the same time. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_BUSY: The service is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This content type is not supported.
errors.PAYMENT_DECLINED: The payment was declined. Check the card details or use another card.
errors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR: The payment provider could not complete the request. Try again shortly.
errors.REDIRECT_NOT_ALLOWED: This return address is not allowed: it must be on the Complytude web app.
errors.PERMISSION_REQUIRED_ANY: Access denied. You need one of these permissions: {permissions}
errors.PERMISSION_REQUIRED_ALL: Access denied. You need all of these permissions: {permissions}
errors.ROLE_REQUIRED: Access denied. You need one of these roles: {roles}
errors.PLATFORM_ROLE_REQUIRED: Platform access requires a platform role.
